stories.title: JSC Building 37
stories.summary: Building 37, Lunar Receiving Laboratory NASA Lyndon B. Johnson Space CenterHouston, Texas Building 37, originally called the Lunar Receiving Laboratory, was renamed Life Sciences Laboratory in 1974. This facility was purpose-built in 1967 to quarantine crews, equipment, and samples returning from the moon, allowing for safe study and scientific analysis following reentry into Earth’s atmosphere.
